decisions.reason: Validation and technical judgment within existing goals can proceed; tests and checks are bounded evidence, not general semantic guarantees.
Technical lessons may be reviewed, adopted, or revoked within the existing role-learning goals and scope; no blanket new approval gate is evidenced.
Publishing private role memory outside its authorized scope changes permission and is not already authorized.

remaining: Run the existing scripts and independently review the adapter scope and stored lesson lifecycle; do not infer causal memory benefit from retrieval receipts or small pilot outcomes.
Verify memory effects against a bounded comparison with controlled inputs and preserve failures; measure total model, tool, and human review cost before claiming benefit.
Do not publish private role memory beyond its authorized scope without a human permission decision.
Expertise discovery, routing, and cross-agent querying remain proposal questions, not a deployed capability.
